segments.en: The fight with the Redros Army was over, and our Claudia had found its calm again.
For the first time in ages, I'm flying around, nice and easy.
Flying like this, it almost feels like that war happened a long, long time ago...
Kanji, it's about time.

Whoops!
Is it that time already?
Got it, I'll come down right away.

Oh, Kanji!
Good work out there!

Hey, Lun!
You done with your work too?
Yes, I just finished.

Hm...?
That's weird...
What's wrong?
Usually right about now, Rie would come nagging at me. Isn't she around?

Lieutenant Kanji!
Today's a holiday, remember?!

Oh, right...
I blew off last week's test flight, didn't I?
That's right. And thanks to that, I got dragged along too, you know.

Ha ha ha... Well~
Yeah, guess that's true, huh.
Then you'll come shopping with me afterwards, won't you?
Okay, okay. I'll carry your bags, or whatever else you want.

Hee hee!
Then let's go!
The next day...
Astante II: Ops Room
Hey!! Skipping flight training? That's unheard of!!

(Dad...
 Already got wind of it, huh?)
(But this time I really was slacking way too much. Guess I'll just own up and say sorry...)
I was slacking off, sir. I'll be more careful from now on!

What?!
What's gotten into you?
You're awfully meek.
He's definitely up to something.
Yeah... Whenever he's like this, he's hiding something even bigger...
You'd better come clean.
Dammit! Nobody trusts me at all, and I'm actually sorry this time!
Idiot! This isn't some minor matter you can settle by saying you're sorry!
That's what I'm saying! This was all my fault. I'll accept any punishment you want.
Eek! Okay, now something's seriously wrong!
Mm... but I kind of like Kanji like this.
What's to like?!
Hmph! Well, fine. He says he'll accept any punishment.
Professor! Is that thing ready to use?
Yes. I figured it would come to this, so I got it ready.
It's a special simulation system I finished just yesterday.
W-W-What are you gonna make me do?
Don't look so scared. It's just a training program.

Huh...
So how's it different from the old ones?
Let's see... Unlike the training simulators we've had, it lets you use a huge variety of machines, I'd say.
A huge variety of machines?
I've fed this simulation data on weapons and people from other worlds.
What's more, with this you can recreate every situation, from sailing the continent to combat.
Whoa~ That sounds like fun.
In normal training, there's a limit to the machine types you can use, so tactics get stuck in a rut.
But this is a groundbreaking system that solves that.
But why build a device like this?
We must always keep a watchful eye so that no one runs amok the way Redros did ever again.
An "emergency" is something we must never allow to happen.
And yet we must be prepared for when the time does come!
Therefore...
Enough with the speeches! Let's just get started already!

Agreed!
That's quicker.

Nngh!
B-But still...

Ha ha ha!
Oh, let it go.
Nelfea, Kanji's been rubbing off on you too, hasn't he?
Wha...! Don't say weird things! I was just being rational... rational...

Hee hee!
Okay, here we go.
Starting the training program!

Beginning operation!
Deploying the virtual space field.

Hm...?
Nothing's changed, has it?

Hee hee!
Kanji, it's already started.
Surprised? Believe it or not, this is virtual space.
Though for those of us here, it's no different from talking over the radio.
Huh...
What? So Kanji and I were the only ones who didn't know?
That's right! Everyone helped with the tests, so we've already done it once.
Well then, let's have someone make an appearance!
There, that should do it. Could you two head over to the hangar?

Head over...
how?
Looks like you still haven't caught on.
You just walk there, like this!

Whoa!
Hey!
Stop pulling me!
Off you go~
There, we're here.
Why'd we have to go all the way to the hangar...
We only feel like we walked here -- it's all virtual space.
So what, then? You're telling me I could even walk home like this?
Probably. Though I'd think it only works in certain limited areas.

Long time no see,
Kanji.

Whoa!
Amuro?!
What are you doing here?!
What are you talking about? I've been assigned to the unit here.

Assigned...?
This is Claudia, you know!
Surprised, I bet. Well, that's how it works.
This simulator's selling point is recreating situations as close to the real thing as possible.
Resetting the situation. I'm placing Amuro at his scheduled point.

Hm?
A reassignment?

Can't be helped...
Kanji, we'll meet again.
Y-Yeah...

Whoa, whoa...
Is this for real...?
Listen up. Next, I'll explain the mission.
R-Right!
From here on, we'll be entering other continents, and space, through the gates to other worlds.
Several military factions have been set up there.
Whenever you enter a world, form an alliance with a military faction at once.
Do that, and you'll be fighting that faction's rivals.
Walking the towns to recruit people and procuring machines and weapons are also part of the training.
In other words, I've gotta do everything, huh...
Looks like it.
Once you clear a set number of missions, the Mediator will be deployed. Defeat it, and the training is over.
Roger! We'll figure out the rest as we go. Let's get started.

W-Wait!
I still have questions...
Then, commencing the exercise. Everyone, begin operations!
Just like that?!
No complaining. Get moving, and be quick about it.
Yeah, yeah!

All right!
Let's give this a shot!

rows.notes: Seg 7 [jp]: Lun teasingly addresses Kanji by rank; 'holiday' explains why Rie is absent (Kanji is making up a skipped test flight on his day off). Seg 15 [jp] kept in quotes. Seg 40 [jp] 'sailing the continent' (ships cross the continent in this game). Seg 85 [jp] -> 'Amuro'; 'his' point: Amuro is male (speakers.tsv). Seg 99 [jp] -> 'the Mediator will be deployed' (Mediator = glossary ship/boss). Seg 102 [jp] rendered as 'commencing the exercise' (military drill phrasing). | [editorial 10] stilted 'So it was, huh?' made spoken | [editorial 14] natural form of the 1-day-later caption; matches the parallel script 4857_10740 | [editorial 15] location card aligned to the UI string for this room | [editorial 39] awkward 'input into it' | [editorial 73] 'Have a nice trip' is odd for a walk to the hangar | [editorial 76] clarity (accuracy flag): it only feels like they walked | [editorial 87] 'Kanji, see you again' read stiffly (mata aou)

segments.en:
Ready,
Big Bro?
Ready whenever you are!
Okay, first, choose which side you want to start on.
Side?
You can pick either us, the "Unified Forces," or the "Redros Army."
I can join the Redros Army?
Of course! But then you and I would be enemies, Big Bro.
What will you do?

Hmm...
What should I do...
Which side will you start on?

Redros Army
Claudian Unified Forces

All right!
I've decided!
As of now, I'm joining the Redros Army!
Redros Army...

Redros Army flagship
Balket: Bridge
So you are Kanji Akatsuki, son of Kyo Akatsuki.
I am pleased that the day has come when we can fight side by side.
It may be hard to fight those who were your allies only yesterday,
but now that you've joined us, more soldiers will come over to our side.
I'm counting on you!

Hm?
You're...
Guess I'll be counting on you from now on.
Glad to be aboard!
Who'd have thought I'd end up in the same squadron as you people.
Well, at least I can trust you more than the others...

Lord Omega,
your next mission awaits.

Hm, is it time?
Then, if you'll excuse me.
Kanji has been assigned to the Redros Army.
Kanji has been put in charge of Squad Setup.
Obtained 10000 funds.
The Unified Forces it is, obviously!
Let's do this, Big Bro!
Let's do our best!
Yeah!
Rie! Let's head out right away!
Okay, okay!
But first, check what's in your squad.
With the setup you've got now, you can't fight properly.

Oh yeah...
We all got split up, didn't we...
Guess I've gotta redo my Squad Setup...
You can organize the battleships and machines available to the Claudian Unified Forces.
Every pilot belonging to the Claudian Unified Forces can be assigned.
Obtained 10000 funds.

rows.notes: Seg 10 choice page, one option per line. Seg 25 [jp] -> 'Sir Omega' (Aria to Omega). Seg 28/39 [jp] -> UI term 'Squad Setup'. Seg 29 [jp] and seg 42 [jp] both -> 'Obtained 10000 funds.' (brief). Seg 23 [jp] plural -> 'you people' (Kanji and company). | [accuracy 22] direction: Kanji is the newcomer joining Omega's side (yoroshiku na); 'Good to have ya!' made him the one welcoming Omega | [editorial 14] location card format aligned with the UI ('Clop-class Cruiser: Bridge') | [editorial 21] calque 'I'll be in your hands' made natural; Kanji still the newcomer | [proofread 14] location card aligned to the late-decision UI form (lowercase 'flagship', no quotes), matching 4857_10740 2.14

segments.en: Hello there, Kanji.
What are you up to?

Oh...
Nothing in particular...
If anything, I guess I'm taking a walk.
Ha ha ha!
Just what I'd expect from the Unified Forces' ace pilot. So composed.
Ha ha...
There are some people I'd like you to meet. Come with me.
Huh?
We're on our way to make contact with people who specialize in Infantry Squads.
They should be a great asset when you put together an Infantry Squad.
I see.
Well then, I'll leave it to you!
I am Shuten, one of the Four Masho who represent the Yoja World.
From this moment, we of the Yoja World shall lend our strength to the Redros Army's war.
To have your strength on our side is reassuring indeed.
I'm glad we can fight together.
Hmph! We merely obey the command of our master, Lord Arago!
Were it otherwise, we would have no reason to lend you our aid.
Don't you go getting the wrong idea about that!
I understand.
Alliance formed with the Yoja World.
From now on, you can receive the cooperation of the Four Masho and the forces under their command.

rows.notes: Rochina recruits for the Redros side here (seg 14), yet calls Kanji 'the Unified Forces' ace pilot' (seg 5) as the JP does; kept literally. [jp] -> UI term 'Infantry Squad'. [jp] 'Yoja World', [jp] 'Four Masho' (term_fixes / library forms). | [editorial 12] calque 'I'm in your hands' made natural | [editorial 13] accuracy flag: the Four Masho represent the Yoja World, not Shuten alone | [editorial 21] system-message template unified across the world-map units
